study_identification_part.si_4_title: Distinct Neurodevelopmental Patterns and Intermediate Integration-Based Predictive Modeling in Autism Spectral Disorder

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized additive models for location, scale and shape (GAMLSS) used for normative trajectories with SHASH distribution.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Generalized additive models for location, scale and shape (GAMLSS) can be used to model multi-parameter distributions; To capture the developmental trajectory of ASD and TD, GAMLSS models were fitted to structural MRI data
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: Modeling developmental trajectories of brain morphology

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Mean cortical thickness (MCT), total surface area (TSA), and total gray matter volume (TGV).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: GAMLSS models were fitted to structural MRI data for the mean CT (MCT), total SA (TSA), and total GV (TGV) separately.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: Modeling developmental trajectories of brain morphology

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age smooth effects with sex and site intercepts (fixed or random effects in candidate models).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We can only choose model age smooth effect for μ and σ (M1a), and add sex and site intercepts for μ and σ as a fixed effect (M1b); adjust sex and site for μ and σ as random effects (M1e).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: Modeling developmental trajectories of brain morphology
